targetText: In short, the Communists everywhere support every revolutionary movement
summary: Communists support all progressive movements that fight against authoritarian regimes and oppression.
context: In 1848, communists aligned with democratic reformers fighting absolute monarchies across Europe.

targetText: The Communists disdain to conceal their views and aims. They openly
summary: Working-class revolutionaries openly state their goals: transforming economic structures to end class exploitation.
context: The Manifesto rejects secret conspiracies in favor of open mass working-class politics.

targetText: The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. They have a world to win.
summary: The closing call states that workers have no property interest in the present order and everything to gain from overturning it.
explanation: The ending contrasts the ruling classes trembling at a communist revolution with a working class that risks only its chains. It fuses the open declaration of aims with the demand for the forcible overthrow of existing social conditions.
context: Combined with the final slogan 'Working Men of All Countries, Unite!', it became the most reproduced line of the socialist movement.
